actionableBootstrapOption: If the coordinator elects a controlled interruption, explicitly replace pre-stop drain proof with a stop-and-reconcile procedure. Do not label it graceful drain or zero downtime.

Prepare the new code with a startup write fence: HTTP session mutations and background keeper/send admission remain disabled until an explicit root-owned reconciliation acknowledgment. Preserve signer identity, files, journals and old image; do not start a second writer with the same key.

Under fresh exact session write gate and independent maintenance handling, record baseline canonical block/nonces, journal hashes and known receipts. Stop the old service separately (not systemctl restart); confirm process and cgroup writers are gone. That establishes no further sends from the old process; in-memory unbroadcast jobs are abandoned, not falsely claimed drained.

Reconcile every sender nonce from baseline through post-stop canonical/pending views across providers. Inspect canonical blocks/receipts by sender and nonce, not only journal hashes. Journal may miss the last broadcast. A nonce without a known receipt remains ambiguous even when public pending equals latest.

Do not allow new business writes to reuse an unresolved nonce. For an ambiguous next nonce, the coordinator must either identify and confirm the old transaction or explicitly approve a bounded same-nonce neutral replacement/cancellation from that SAME existing relayer account, with gas authority and fee cap checked. This can consume real gas and cancel an old request; it is not authorized by this audit. A fresh signer is not needed for this option, but existing gas balance/authority must be verified.

If cancellation races inclusion, resolve which same-nonce transaction became canonical and reconcile its effects before proceeding. Do not replay the old business action. If outcome/fees cannot be resolved within the maintenance bound, retain the new process write fence and report manual recovery; reopening the gateway alone must not enable sends.

Start the new relay with writes fenced to restore fleet connectivity/read surfaces, if that startup mode has actually been implemented and tested. Release writes only after durable receipt/state reconciliation and a new queue admission/drain control are verified. Original session funds stay put unless a separately authorized confirmed transaction moves them.
nonDisruptionConstraint: Strictly uninterrupted old-process fleet tunnels plus a new in-process barrier is unavailable through existing read-only interfaces. Additive sidecar needs independently funded/authorized gas and explicit original-fund migration; it is not a free solution.

legitimateTerminationBarrier.sourceProof: Installed sessions.mjs829-835/857-858 owner terminate and871-873 session terminate both call simulateAndSend, which enqueues at543. Only one production queue is constructed408; attestorEnv1281-1291 supplies no injected alternate queue.
legitimateTerminationBarrier.positiveConclusion: A canonically confirmed successful actual migration termination at nonce N, with ended session and exact owner refund verified, is a real budget barrier and completed queue-prefix marker. It establishes canonical consumption through nonce N; no dummy send or new signer is needed to establish this prefix.
legitimateTerminationBarrier.notFullDrain: Previously admitted preflights may enqueue later: open, owner operations, attestation, execute, already-active keeper. Gateway gate prevents new requests, not previously disconnected work. SID termination does not revoke owner-operation or other grant signatures. Future keeper scans skip ended rows, but existing calls are not cancelled.
legitimateTerminationBarrier.queueErrors: Promise tail catches prior rejection, so barrier completion does not imply every prior operation succeeded. Canonical termination and lower-nonce receipt/state reconciliation still required.
legitimateTerminationBarrier.bootstrap: After legitimate signed termination and verified refund, maintain gate, stop old writer explicitly, and reconcile all postbarrier nonces>N before enabling new writes or grants. This reduces the unknown window while preserving funds; it is a controlled stop-and-reconcile, not graceful drain. Do not silently omit any unknown outcome.
legitimateTerminationBarrier.authorization: No new signature requested or transaction sent. Coordinator must present exact migration/refund/new grant terms and obtain required actual signatures; existing original30 not assumed independently spendable.
